scripts.test: docker build -t test . && docker run -p 8084:8082 test
scripts.push: sh -c 'IMAGE=europe-west1-docker.pkg.dev/vf-grp-aib-prd-ncl-tax-lab/docker-images/tax-trans-price; LATEST=$(gcloud artifacts docker tags list $IMAGE --format="value(tag)" 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^v[0-9]+$" | sed "s/^v//" | sort -n | tail -1); if [ -z "$LATEST" ]; then V="v1"; else V="v$((LATEST + 1))"; fi; echo "Deploying version $V..."; docker build -t tax-trans-price:$V . && docker tag tax-trans-price:$V $IMAGE:$V && docker push $IMAGE:$V' --
